proposals.rule: Check each estimated payment against the agency transcript. Do not let the client's questionnaire amount fill in a quarter when the IRS or FTB record shows a different amount for that quarter.
proposals.firesWhen: The line includes a payment that came from client text, or a payment the confirmation marks for another tax year, and the transcript for that date shows a different amount or no 2025 credit.
proposals.silentWhen: Every payment on the line matches a transcript entry for 2025 in date and amount.

proposals.rule: When a donated vehicle's Form 1098-C has box 4a checked, the Form 8283 vehicle value cannot exceed the box 4c gross proceeds.
proposals.firesWhen: Box 4a is checked and the claimed value is above box 4c.
proposals.silentWhen: Box 4a is not checked, box 5 (significant use) applies, or the claimed value is at or below box 4c.

proposals.rule: A payoff statement interest amount must not be added to a mortgage interest line when the Form 1098 printed text says box 1 already includes the payoff interest.
proposals.firesWhen: The same line cites both, and the 1098 or the payoff page says the interest is reported on the 1098.
proposals.silentWhen: The payoff interest is for a lender with no 1098, or the 1098 says it excludes the payoff.

proposals.rule: Find information returns from the same payer that report the same interest, such as a composite 1099 sweep section and a standalone 1099-INT for the same sweep program, when each is landed on its own Schedule B line.
proposals.firesWhen: Two Schedule B lines carry the same amount from the same payer or sweep program across two documents.
proposals.silentWhen: The account numbers or amounts differ, or one document is marked superseded.

proposals.rule: For a broker lot with zero or missing basis, look for a matching lot on a stock plan supplemental statement (same shares and date acquired) and use its adjusted basis.
proposals.firesWhen: Broker basis is zero and a supplement lot with the same acquisition date and share count gives nonzero adjusted basis that is not applied.
proposals.silentWhen: No supplement lot matches, or the supplement basis is already used.

proposals.rule: Mileage page totals from pages the duplicate check flags as near or identical copies, or whose printed text says second scan, must count only once.
proposals.firesWhen: A line sums page totals from two pages with word similarity of at least 0.9 and the same page total.
proposals.silentWhen: The pages cover different date ranges or have different trip lists.

proposals.rule: Do not add Form 1099-K gross to Schedule C receipts as unmatched when books transaction detail says the card receipts were deposited gross into recorded sales.
proposals.firesWhen: The books detail names the 1099-K processor and an amount equal to box 1a as included in deposits, yet the engine adds box 1a.
proposals.silentWhen: No books detail ties the 1099-K to recorded deposits.

proposals.rule: A foreign-currency income line must use a rate for the same tax year as the income.
proposals.firesWhen: The cited fx reference period year differs from the tax year of the income it converts.
proposals.silentWhen: The rate period matches the tax year, or the line is a year-end balance that uses the year-end rate.

proposals.rule: Flag a broker document page that has an extraction status of partial with pages not read, and compare the 1099-B summary proceeds with the sum of the lots landed on the return.
compares: sum of F8949 lot proceeds per broker
proposals.firesWhen: A page was not read and the summary proceeds differ from the sum of landed lots.
proposals.silentWhen: All pages were read and the totals agree.

proposals.rule: Flag an expense whose transaction detail names a family or multi-line plan, a shared home service, or a personal subscription, when the client text gives a business-use share below 100% or calls the item personal.
proposals.firesWhen: The full books amount is deducted and the client text gives a lower business share or says the item is personal.
proposals.silentWhen: No business-use share is stated or the line already applies it.

proposals.rule: An owner-statement repair entry that an invoice describes as replacing a whole building system, with words like removed, installed new system or permit, should go to a capitalisation review instead of repairs.
proposals.firesWhen: A repair line includes an item whose invoice describes full system replacement over the de minimis threshold.
proposals.silentWhen: The invoice describes a part repair or routine maintenance below the threshold.

proposals.rule: California source wages for a part-year resident must be split by residency dates and not taken straight from W-2 box 16 when the W-2 text says the payroll work state was kept after the move date.
proposals.firesWhen: Box 16 California wages include pay periods after the move-out date given in the questionnaire.
proposals.silentWhen: The household was resident all year, or the W-2 box 16 stops at the move date.
